code_provenance_note: Archive HEAD is not asserted to be the experimental revision. Original reports retain runtime/reference/tool SHA256 maps; historical experiments included uncommitted code. Current engine may differ.
curation_note: Sufficient metrics and per-sample CSVs only. Full outputs remain at recorded source paths. Historical code commits may be unknown; retained runtime hashes identify measured sources.
dates_note: Per-file source_mtime_utc is archival metadata, not guaranteed experiment start. Original run timestamps, registration Unix times and status provenance are retained.

diagnostics.json.purpose: Long-context logit buckets and identical-logit sampler distributions (TV, support, entropy).

equivalence.json.purpose: Per-layout aggregate G-TF metrics and reference limits, generated registration timestamps/hashes, greedy medians.

exact.json.purpose: Engine-vs-reference counts of the CPU comparisons asserted at atol=rtol=0 (tiny sets, 4096-token tiny probe, 8-token probes of full-size checkpoints, constructor cases).

memory_ab.json.purpose: Old/new host-swap comparisons at 8 GiB and 0.5 GiB, including output identity and RSS growth.

method.json.purpose: Declared analysis policy and reproduction runtimes; r1o runtime derived from r1o.json saved block times.

negative.json.purpose: Compile-enabled throughput and failing learned-decider numerical/greedy checks.

port.json.purpose: Validation of the engine on a second GPU (L40S): environment, default suite, W-smoke graph/eager identity, overlap identity.

r1/runs.json.purpose: Confirmatory R1 status, groups, settings, telemetry and source provenance.

r1/samples.csv.purpose: Confirmatory R1 per-sample results; only fields used by analysis and comparison are retained.

r1o.json.purpose: Amended confirmatory R1-O: validity, forced means/bias, both tail looks, descriptive maxima, C1, diagnostics, block timings and provenance; no raw arrays

r2_speed.json.purpose: R2 generated-token throughput by 8192-token benchmark, plus inputs to the approximate KV-capacity comparison.

robustness.json.purpose: Swap identity, long-generation/prompt and restart completion/cleanup; overlap composition-controlled identity.

speed.json.purpose: Generation counts, seconds, peak bytes and step profile; reference has a different memory/timing scope.
